extension.news:
v1.4.4 (2026-11-03) - Keep series and episodes usable when genres, series, or season metadata is missing or null. - Validate optional catalogue structures explicitly without suppressing unrelated exceptions. - Add regression coverage for incomplete genre and season metadata. - Thanks to GitHub user hypnotoad for reporting these edge cases in pull request #1.
v1.4.3 (2026-11-01) - Handle a cancelled search as an empty result instead of a directory error. - Add regression coverage for cancelling the Kodi search input dialog.
v1.4.2 (2026-11-01) - Keep the "New films" directory usable when Filmfriend returns a null release date. - Add regression coverage for missing and malformed catalogue dates. - Retain the Kodi 21 Omega Widevine playback path used with InputStream Adaptive 21.5.25.
v1.4.1 (2026-09-01) - Identify this release as macsobeck's independent fork of Ingo-FP-Angel's add-on for promptly handling Stuttgart changes. - Support Filmfriend v18 integrated external providers such as Stadtbibliothek Stuttgart. - Retain compatibility with the older OpenId and delegated/IP provider metadata. - Publish the current independent macsobeck release.
v1.4.0 (2026-09-01) - Create an independent local fork maintained by macsobeck. - Use a distinct add-on ID so repositories for the former add-on cannot update this fork. - Migrate existing library, provider, and token settings once without logging their values.
v1.3.4 (2026-07-24) - Fix Widevine startup on Kodi 21 by using only the supported drm_legacy interface. - Prevent InputStream Adaptive from rejecting mixed DRM properties before license acquisition.
v1.3.3 (2026-07-24) - Move catalogue, metadata, watchlist, and playback requests to Filmfriend's current tenant API v18. - Translate existing Kodi menu filters to the v18 search contract without changing the UI. - Stop treating legacy public-catalogue HTTP 401 responses as expired user sessions. - Adapt series and episode navigation to the current parent-resource endpoints.
v1.3.2 (2026-07-24) - Fix Kodi 21 validation of hidden authentication migration settings. - Preserve the legacy Filmfriend search URL and retry catalogue HTTP 401 responses with the bearer token. - Add credential-safe endpoint diagnostics for API failures.
v1.3.1 (2026-07-24) - Make token refresh concurrency-safe and retry authenticated requests once after HTTP 401. - Add testable API/authentication services and non-destructive settings migration. - Add structured diagnostics with mandatory credential redaction. - Update Kodi 21 Widevine properties while retaining the Omega-compatible legacy path.
v1.3.0 (2026-07-13) - Add support for SWITCH edu-ID based login (by CorentinWicht)
v1.2.3 (2026-07-09) - Add support for libraries in Belgium, Liechtenstein and Luxembourg.
v1.2.2 (2026-07-08) - Add support for French libraries.
v1.2.1 (2026-07-05) - Fix login for Munich (and likely other libraries with "external" login).
v1.2.0 (2026-07-04) - Change the way the addon authenticates for certain libraries in order to support the Berlin and Stuttgart libraries again (by H3rby7).
v1.1.1 (2026-04-12) - Fix issue refreshing an expired access token that was introduced in v1.1.0.
v1.1.0 (2025-12-19) - Change the way the addon authenticates for certain libraries in order to support the Hamburg library again. This also adds support for Stadtbibliothek Darmstadt.
v1.0.15 (2025-11-22) - Fix a crash when showing all available series from the main menu
v1.0.14 (2025-02-13) - Add menu entry to browse videos by genre (by rantan-plan) - Preselect library and credentials during (re-)login if present (by rantan-plan) - Internal code optimizations
v1.0.13 (2025-02-04) - Tell user to login again manually when automatic token refresh failed
v1.0.12 (2024-08-02) - Fix sorting of seasons and episodes of a series
v1.0.11 (2024-04-21) - Add support for IP based login - Show an error if a library only offers login methods not supported by this addon
v1.0.10 (2024-02-27) - Add support for Austrian and Swiss libraries On login users now first have to select their country
v1.0.9 (2024-02-05) - Automatically refresh an expired access_token When updating from an earlier version, the autorefresh only works after the next manual login
extension.summary: This video add-on provides access to shows and movies of Filmfriend.
extension.description: This video add-on provides access to shows and movies of Filmfriend. It is an independent macsobeck-maintained fork of Ingo-FP-Angel's add-on, created to handle authentication changes required by Stadtbibliothek Stuttgart promptly. A valid library account is required in order to use this add-on. Supports libraries in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Belgium, Luxembourg, and France. UI languages: German and English.
extension.disclaimer: Free for everyone to use, study, modify and share under GPL-2.0-only. Independent macsobeck-maintained fork of Ingo-FP-Angel's add-on; not affiliated with Filmfriend.
